decisions.evidence: Across all six neighbors, the same pattern repeats: the query consistently carries 2,3-dihydro-1H-indene, matches the ring count of the mutagenic neighbors, and often shows a higher fraction of sp3 carbons, while the opposing signals are mainly higher QED drug-likeness, more aliphatic carbocycles, and in one case a lower maximum absolute partial charge. The positive neighbors are all mutagenic, and even the negative neighbors still share enough of the query’s mutagenic-leaning features that the overall local analog evidence favors option (B): is mutagenic.
